name: The Hamptons

known.via: English Wikipedia "The Hamptons, Long Island AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Merlot, Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil drains fast and warms early in spring. Vines get little water, which keeps crops small and flavors concentrated, but drought bites hard. It is very acid, which locks up nutrients, so growers spread lime to raise the pH.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
